title: Aegix Pulse: A Traceable Three-Stage Architecture for Personalized Content Generation and Context-Preserving Revision
abstract: arXiv:2609.07672v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Production content-generation systems must integrate a user's immediate task, long-term brand identity, historical evidence, and revision feedback. We present Aegix Pulse, a production-oriented three-stage architecture that separates current-task clarification and Task Persona finalization, long-term Account Profile (Brand DNA) assembly, and controlled generation and revision while preserving provenance across content versions.   We evaluate four preregistered claims using 96 synthetic social-media generation tasks. Four initial-generation conditions progressively introduced a Task Persona, Account Profile, and successful-history style evidence, while two revision conditions compared plain and context-preserving revision. The experiment produced 480 completed generation records and 1,440 blinded LLM-Judge evaluations, supplemented by human review. translated_title: Aegix Pulse：一种用于个性化内容生成与上下文保持修订的可追溯三阶段架构
translated_abstract: 生产级内容生成系统必须整合用户的即时任务、长期品牌形象、历史证据和修订反馈。我们提出了Aegix Pulse，一种面向生产环境的三阶段架构，将当前任务澄清与任务角色（Task Persona）最终确定、长期账户档案（品牌DNA）组装、以及受控生成与修订三个阶段分离开来，同时在整个内容版本中保持出处可追溯性。我们使用96个合成社交媒体生成任务评估了四个预先注册的研究声明。四个初始生成条件逐步引入任务角色、账户档案和成功历史风格证据，而两个修订条件则对比了普通修订与上下文保持修订。实验产生了480条完整的生成记录和1,440次盲测LLM评审评估，并辅以人工审查。添加账户档案使平均品牌一致性得分提高了0.1562分
tldr: Aegix Pulse提出了一种可追溯的三阶段架构，通过分离任务澄清、品牌档案组装和受控生成修订流程，在个性化内容生成中显著提升了品牌一致性，并通过上下文保持修订保证了跨版本内容的出处可追溯性。
en_tdlr: Aegix Pulse presents a traceable three-stage architecture that separates task clarification, brand profile assembly, and controlled generation/revision, significantly improving brand consistency in personalized content generation while ensuring provenance across content versions through context-preserving revision.
